Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: square website process-step photo for step 02, sharing artwork
Primary request: Create a photorealistic, high-resolution square editorial product photo of an apparel artwork review desk. Use the provided reference image as the exact visual reference for the matching product pair and emblem. Show one blank ivory/off-white crewneck T-shirt and one blank navy baseball cap on the desk, beside a clean print-ready color artwork sheet. Center the artwork sheet as the step-02 focus and show the exact same circular emblem from the reference clearly on the sheet: coral upper semicircle sunset; lower half contains TWO dark teal/blue wavy bands separated by fine ivory wave lines. Input images: Image 1: reference image for exact emblem geometry/colors, garment colors, product styles and natural product-photography palette; create a new scene and composition.
Scene/backdrop: warm, tidy apparel design studio desk with paper proof and subtle fabric swatches.
Subject: artwork proof with reference emblem, plus one blank ivory crewneck T-shirt and one blank navy baseball cap.
Style/medium: realistic premium editorial product photography, natural material texture.
Composition/framing: square crop; elevated three-quarter desk view, clear artwork sheet near center and both blank items fully recognizable, distinct from the reference laptop-and-hands approval photo.
Lighting/mood: soft natural window light, warm wood, calm and considered.
Color palette: ivory, navy, warm wood, coral, teal and deep blue.
Materials/textures: uncoated proof paper, cotton jersey, cotton twill cap, subtle woven texture.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: the sheet's emblem must closely match Image 1: one circular mark, coral sun on top, TWO dark teal/blue wave bands below separated by thin ivory curves. Only the paper proof bears the emblem in this artwork-sharing scene; T-shirt and cap stay blank. No visible lettering.
Avoid: stars, mountains, mountain sketches, extra logos, extra products or emblems, words, letters, watermark, laptop, hands, packaging, mockup diagrams.
